A new acceptance suite says how it runs from its own folder, so adding one needs no signed approval
A standing run: issues that meet a rule you approved join on their own, so new work needs no new approval
A hub on Linux can confirm a person: pairing, links and answers work with no Secure Enclave, and the service stays up after logout
Asks reach the right person: each ask names who answers, a second person covers, the answerer is recorded and nobody is asked twice
Give it a repo link: everything is set up from that one input, you answer one card, and work starts
The project page: what needs you on top, the project as a picture below, and nothing else unless you look
Demo: a repo link and a topic each become a running project, where you answer one card and then hear only what needs you
Taste calls wait for you, the work doesn't: a reversible change lands on everything else, and its calls reach you in one batch
Starting from nothing: a person with no agent and no developer tools gets from the download to a first result
Demo: two people who never touch a terminal get a trip plan and a client's monthly report from one sentence each, and see only what needs them
A started session commits in its own worktree, and the checkout and other worktrees stay closed to it
The budget window can close only budget-only issues: nothing ticks the criteria a Part of merge proved
The proof guard covers main-watch.mjs, known-failures-check.mjs and every key of known-failures.json
Listed failures end: a listed test that passes fails the lane, lint and timing entries lapse, and the main watch excuses timing only under load
Closed issues stay proven: a sweep finds each criterion of a closed issue that no test names, and reopens the issue naming it
contracts: build.rolled_back@1 lacks the shared envelope's evidence and the read cap on commit and restored (2 events tests fail on main)
The design can be read a section at a time: AGENTS.md asks for the sections an issue links, one script prints a section by its anchor, and a section's size only drops
The design states its principles once: a short section at the top of the technical design, each line linking the rule it comes from and naming the check that holds it
Each design section shows the work filed against it: one script lists every linked section with its closed and open issues, so built and designed are counted and not estimated
